document_title: Continuing Existing Projects and History System
description: What happens when you return to a book you've worked on before

opening_the_same_epub_again.scenario: You processed chapters 1-10 last week, now you open the same EPUB again
what_you_see: '⚠️ This book has been processed before:'

what_happens: Program automatically suggests starting from chapter 11
Uses same settings as last time (voice, quality, etc.)
Output goes to same project folder

option_2_new_project.description: Start a new project with different settings

option_3_reprocess.description: Redo the same chapters (replace old files)
what_happens: Warning shown: '⚠️ This will overwrite existing output files!'
Same chapters processed again with current settings

different_epub_same_story.scenario: You downloaded a different version of the same novel (different file name)
different_epub_same_story.how_detected: The program calculates a unique fingerprint for each EPUB file

if_same_content.what_you_see: '🔍 This appears to be the same book as: The Uzumaki Legend (processed Dec 15)'
if_same_content.explanation: Even though file name is different, the content is identical
if_same_content.option: Treat as same project or create new one

if_different_content.what_you_see: No warning - treated as a completely new book
if_different_content.example: You had 'Uzumaki Legend v1.epub' and now have 'Uzumaki Legend v2.epub' with new chapters

similar_book_names.scenario: You're processing 'The Legend Returns' but have an old project called 'The Legend'
similar_book_names.if_you_say_yes: The new book is linked to the existing project
similar_book_names.if_you_say_no: A separate new project is created

scenario_1_complete_overlap.what_you_see: '⚠️ These exact chapters were already processed!'

scenario_2_partial_overlap.what_you_see: '⚠️ Chapters 1-10 overlap with previous work. 11-15 are new.'

scenario_3_boundary_overlap.what_you_see: 'ℹ️ Chapter 10 was in your previous batch. Start from 10 or 11?'
scenario_3_boundary_overlap.recommendation: Start from 11 to avoid duplicate chapter

project_folder_structure.continuation_benefit: When you continue a project, all your settings are remembered

what_you_see: '📋 Found saved settings for this book:'

when_you_finish_a_book.all_chapters_done: You've processed all 50 chapters of a 50-chapter book

archiving_completed_projects.what_you_might_see: '📦 This book is fully processed! Archive project? (y/n)'

if_you_archive.what_happens: Project folder moves from 'Active Novels' to 'Archived Novels'
if_you_archive.why: Keeps your active projects list clean
if_you_archive.files_preserved: All your output files are kept in the archive

novel_name_mapping.what_this_solves: You might upload to YouTube with a different title than the EPUB had

example.mapping_saved: Program remembers that these are the same story

later_benefit.when_searching: 'What's the original file for The Uzumaki Legend?'
